headline: A small ON RRP print puts the calendar—not overnight pricing—at the center of the dollar-funding test
dek: ON RRP take-up was $1.42B, an unusual daily change on a near-zero base but not a large flow. Seiche’s EROSION reading is driven by a dated reserve path; SOFR below IORB and unused repo backstop capacity still argue against current broad scarcity.

newsworthiness.rule: a full story needs a fresh measured change and at least 55 points; levels, persistence and quiet tapes remain labelled briefs or watch notes

limitations: The composite is a Seiche derivation, not an observed market price.
Source publication time is not yet collected uniformly; event, desk-knowledge and publication clocks remain separate.
Related Palimpsest readings are context-only and never enter the composite or a model feature.

review_notes: Recast the ON RRP observation as a small, unusual print rather than evidence of a large flow.
Made the calendar-to-cash-price transmission mechanism conditional and observable.
Strengthened the counter-case around SOFR, IORB, repo-backstop use, and market-stress evidence.
Added the required research boundary, source links, and explicit model limits.
Removed the unsupported reserve-gap figure while retaining the observed reserve level and fitted-kink estimate.
Preserved the conditional calendar-to-funding mechanism and the observable falsification test.
Retained the counter-case centered on SOFR, IORB, Standing Repo Facility use, and market stress.
